upstream_title: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands and Sensitivity Analysis in Clinical Trials
capture_method: official-source text inspection; normalized metadata and paraphrased evidence only

locators.claim: An estimand is described through treatment, population, variable, intercurrent-event handling and population-level summary attributes.
The main estimator and analysis should align with the target estimand.
Sensitivity analyses examine robustness to assumptions relevant to the main estimand.

locators.section: A.6 Documenting Estimands and Sensitivity Analysis
locators.claim: Estimands and sensitivity analyses should be documented as part of planned trial analysis.

rights_note: This repository stores only project-authored metadata and paraphrases; consult the official ICH document for authoritative wording.
